props.text: Reduced DIRTY PR close timeout from 7 days to 72 hours (self-improve Step 0.5)

In an autonomous repo, DIRTY (conflicting) PRs never self-resolve — no human resolves merge conflicts. The 7-day wait created a dead zone where the PR blocked re-proposal but would never merge. Observed: PR #70 (skill-leaderboard fix) has been DIRTY for 48h+ and would sit until Oct 19 before closure.

PR #70 included volatile files (memory/logs/, .outputs/) in its commit, causing immediate merge conflicts. The underlying improvement is valid but the PR is dead on arrival. With the old 7-day timeout, re-proposal was delayed by ~10 days total (7d wait + next self-improve run). With 72h, it closes by Oct 15 and gets re-proposed Oct 16.
skills/self-improve/SKILL.md: DIRTY PR close threshold 7d → 72h; added jq-based age computation (prevents LLM date math errors); updated UNKNOWN fall-through cross-reference

Faster cleanup of dead PRs, faster re-proposal of improvements. Aligns the DIRTY threshold with the existing UNKNOWN force-merge threshold (72h), creating consistency across all PR-age decisions in Step 0.5.
